provenance: Derived from pot_all exact-match misses caused by excess decimals or missing percent/unit symbols.

semantic_labels.label: output.precision_and_units
semantic_labels.description: Round numeric answers and preserve requested units/symbols.

scope.observed_error: numeric answers used too many decimals or omitted expected unit/percent formatting

payload.content: For numeric answers, match the question's requested precision and unit style. Round percentages and decimals to the shortest reasonable form, usually two decimals when a statistic is requested, and preserve symbols such as `%` when the answer is a percentage.
